source: RogueLife/Teni Podgorya concept art generated in chat
notes: IDs exactly match js/data.js so the renderer never guesses entity identity.
Entities without an image keep the existing geometric fallback renderer.
Framing per asset lives in js/visual-assets.js: focusX/focusY is the point of the source that lands in the token centre, zoom is how much smaller the cropped square is than the short side.
Bosses grazgot and morgul still need dedicated art; the cave-troll image now serves only the troll monster it depicts.
